answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 46 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a ripple bet on surviving 46 epochs of grading, and every raven settlement recomputes the quartz schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 11 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 40 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
